name: Hydroxyethyl urea
description: Hydroxyethyl urea (CAS 1320-51-0 ) is a urea-based humectant used primarily in personal care formulations and industrial processing applications. It attracts and retains moisture within substrates effectively. This chemical serves as a functional alternative to glycerin and conventional urea in leave-on and rinse-off systems. In skin and hair care, it is incorporated into moisturizers, serums, and conditioners. The ingredient delivers sustained hydration without the tackiness associated with high-glycerin formulations. Textile processors use it as a hygroscopic finishing agent to improve fabric hand-feel and reduce static. It is effective in synthetic and natural fiber treatments. In leather processing, it supports uniform penetration of dyes and softening agents by maintaining substrate moisture during tanning operations. Home care formulators include it in fabric softeners and surface cleaners where controlled moisture retention improves product performance. It is typically supplied as a clear to slightly yellow aqueous solution. The product is most commonly available at a 50% active concentration. Cosmetic-grade material is the predominant commercial specification, with quality aligned to personal care industry standards. These standards ensure low impurity profiles for sensitive applications.
